title: Stop Waiting For The Perfect Time | A Discipline Short Film
lines: He kept waiting for the perfect time.
Better weather. More money. Less fear.
But the perfect time never knocks.
It's a story we tell ourselves to stay safe.
The best time to start was a year ago. The second best is now.
Start messy. Start scared. Start anyway.
Momentum doesn't care how perfect the first step was.
